digest.component_or_area: fsck command suite and store layer module organization
propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) currently live in fsck_repair.py but have no repair-related logic and are imported by seven production modules across multiple subsystems, creating an inverted dependency.

Moving the three primitives from fsck_repair.py to gitutil.py as their canonical home eliminates the inverted dependency, maintains gitutil as a stdlib-only leaf module, and keeps all module LOC under the 800-line cap.

Two compatibility surfaces must be preserved: fsck.py must continue re-exporting _ticket_dirs and _resolve_tracker_git_dir, and fsck_repair.py must maintain module-level bindings for all three names so that existing test monkeypatches via setattr(fsck_repair, ...) continue to work without test file edits.

The move introduces no circular imports because every consumer is a _commands module importing _store, which is the existing dependency direction, and _dir_is_archived's function-local import of rebar.reducer._api._is_net_archived remains deferred.
